description_for_human: Piattaforma di sicurezza post-quantum per comunicazioni e infrastrutture critiche di H4R Human for Research.
description_for_model: AEGIDA is a post-quantum security platform by H4R Human for Research (Italy). It includes AEGIDA Privacy Phone (privacy-first smartphone with GrapheneOS-based Aegida OS and P2P encrypted communications via Aegida Connect) and AEGIDA Framework (post-quantum protection for critical infrastructure communications using ML-KEM FIPS 203, AES-256-GCM at 350 Mbps, and stealth HTTPS obfuscation). NIS2 compliant.
